summary: These tables cover activity from July 1, 2007, through June 30, 2008, for IPEDS-eligible postsecondary institutions, reported at the institution and undergraduate/graduate level. The survey measures students served or instructional activity over the full 12-month period, making it applicable to institutions with nontraditional calendars and short-term programs. Reporting was optional for institutions in even-numbered years, so 2008 (even) may have missing institution-level data.

These tables report fall enrollment and related institution-level measures from participating IPEDS institutions. Traditional academic-year institutions report enrollment as of October 15 or their official fall reporting date, while institutions with program-specific or continuous calendars report students enrolled at any time from August 1 through October 31. Records are generally institution-level, with table-specific student or institutional breakdowns and eligibility restrictions; the applicable universe is institutions participating in Fall Enrollment reporting.

Finance reports institutional financial activity for fiscal years ending between July 1, 2007 and June 30, 2008, collected during the 2008–09 IPEDS reporting cycle. The unit of observation is the postsecondary institution, with one institutional finance record covering revenues, expenditures, assets, and liabilities. The survey covers IPEDS institutions eligible for inclusion in the Finance component; private institutions report annually, while public institutions report in even-numbered years, so 2008 (even) has public-institution data. Institutions report according to their accounting basis, with separate GASB, FASB, and for-profit reporting forms.

The 2008 Graduation Rates survey reports the status, as of August 31, 2008, of cohorts of full-time, first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduates, using completion within 150% of normal time and transfer-out outcomes. It covers eligible institutions with such undergraduate cohorts, with cohort years varying by institution level: 2002 for four-year institutions and 2005 for two-year and less-than-two-year institutions. Results are reported as counts for cohort and outcome categories rather than as institution-wide enrollment totals.

Human Resources reports institution-level staff counts for the fall payroll snapshot as of November 1, 2008, along with salary and fringe-benefit information for the 2008-09 academic year; new-hire counts cover hires between July 1 and October 31, 2008. Tables contain multiple records per institution, with each record identified by the table’s occupational, personnel, contract, rank, benefit, or other classification fields. Applicable IPEDS institutions and related administrative offices report the data, with eligibility and institution-size restrictions varying by table; race/ethnicity and gender reporting was optional in this even-numbered year, and 2008 was the first year of the two-year transition to new race/ethnicity categories.

These institution-level tables cover the 2008-09 academic year and are collected during the annual Institutional Characteristics collection window. The universe is the 2008 IPEDS postsecondary institution universe, including active institutions and Title IV-participating institutions for which IPEDS reporting is mandatory; institutions report only the applicable fields and forms. Reporting may represent a parent or child campus rather than an individual physical campus, and applicability varies with institutional structure, admissions policy, and program calendar.
